name: orbital-signal
description: libsignal bindings for Orbital-Mobile via uniffi-bindgen-react-native
author: Pure Karma Labs

scripts.comment:marker: build:ios[:release] write rust-profile-ios.txt as 'profile line + scripts/rust-input-digest.sh output', AFTER a successful ubrn build: ubrn runs an unlocked `cargo metadata` first and can rewrite Cargo.lock, so the digest must describe what was actually compiled. Staged via .tmp + mv so a digest failure leaves NO marker (scripts/verify-rust-profile-ios.sh fails closed on a missing or digest-less marker).
scripts.build:ios: rm -f rust-profile-ios.txt rust-profile-ios.txt.tmp && ubrn build ios --config ubrn.config.yaml --and-generate && { echo debug && bash ../../scripts/rust-input-digest.sh; } > rust-profile-ios.txt.tmp && mv rust-profile-ios.txt.tmp rust-profile-ios.txt
scripts.build:ios:release: rm -f rust-profile-ios.txt rust-profile-ios.txt.tmp && ubrn build ios --config ubrn.config.yaml --release --and-generate && { echo release && bash ../../scripts/rust-input-digest.sh; } > rust-profile-ios.txt.tmp && mv rust-profile-ios.txt.tmp rust-profile-ios.txt
scripts.build:android: rm -f android/src/main/jniLibs/rust-profile.txt && ubrn build android --config ubrn.config.yaml --and-generate && echo debug > android/src/main/jniLibs/rust-profile.txt
scripts.build:android:release: rm -f android/src/main/jniLibs/rust-profile.txt && ubrn build android --config ubrn.config.yaml --release --and-generate && echo release > android/src/main/jniLibs/rust-profile.txt
